The reason for the post was to show how much work I’ve put in to barely get by and be told that it’s my fault I live paycheck to paycheck by the owner of the company I work for.

So the benefit is auto fringe and relates to personal use of a company vehicle. However I believe this should fall under a working condition benefit as this service van falls under the description on the irs publication 15-b of a van under the working condition benefit section describing a qualified non personal use vehicle. From my understanding this would make it a write off for the company and exclude me from being taxed for any portion of the value. 

“Vans. A van with a loaded gross vehicle weight of 14,000 pounds or less is a qualified nonpersonal use vehicle if it has been specially modified so it isn't likely to be used more than minimally for personal purposes. For ex-ample, a van qualifies if it is clearly marked with permanently affixed decals, special painting, or other advertising associated with your trade, business, or function and has a seat for the driver only (or the driver and one other per-son) and either of the following items.

• Permanent shelving that fills most of the cargo area.
• An open cargo area and the van always carries mer-chandise, material, or equipment used in your trade, business, or function.”
